## BOTANICAL AND ECOLOGICAL CHARACTERISTICS to 100 feet (8-30 m) tall with a solitary trunk or up to 20 feet (5 m) tall | | | |-|-| | ![](https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/tree/quegar/brewersoak.jpg) | **Varieties and hybrids:**
Brewer's oak is a spreading, clonal shrub up to 20 feet (5 m) tall with smooth bark. Leaves are
1 to 4 inches (3-9 cm) long, and acorns are less than 1 inch (3 cm) long [ [40](https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/tree/quegar/all.html#40), [62](https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/tree/quegar/all.html#62), [101](https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/tree/quegar/all.html#101), [106](https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/tree/quegar/all.html#106)].
_Quercus garryana_ var. _garryana_ is a tree that may reach 70 feet (20 m)
tall with large leaves that measure 3 to 5.5 inches (7-14 cm) long [ [40](https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/tree/quegar/all.html#40), [62](https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/tree/quegar/all.html#62)]. The description of
_Q. g._ var. _semota_ is much like that of Brewer's oak,
but acorns are typically larger [ [40](https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/tree/quegar/all.html#40), [101](https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/tree/quegar/all.html#101)]. Epling's oak, Howell's oak, and _Q._ × _subconvexa_
are described in [ [101](https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/tree/quegar/all.html#101)]. |
